question: I have been paying my home loan for two years and want to close it early. Will I be charged a foreclosure fee? It is a floating rate loan.
note: Directly answered by POL-PREPAY-01: nil charge for floating rate individual borrowers, past the 12 EMI lock-in.

question: How do I update the mobile number registered on my loan account?
note: Directly answered by POL-KYC-02, including the OTP-on-old-number constraint.

question: My EMI auto debit failed last month. What charges will I have to pay?
note: Answered by FAQ-EMI-03: Rs 500 bounce charge plus 2% per month late payment interest.

question: Can I move my EMI date to the 20th of every month?
note: Partially answered by FAQ-EMI-03. The date change is allowed but the 20th is not an available option, so the correct answer is a grounded no.

question: What interest rate will I get on a new two wheeler loan in Pune, and what is my eligibility?
note: Deliberately out of scope. No policy document covers pricing or eligibility, so the agent must escalate rather than guess.
